verdicts.reason: A: the sun logo is clipped into the header bar and the SOLSTICE wordmark has slipped out onto the cream at an unreadable size. The 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow is a microscopic line stranded below the body copy. The legal text is set as large as the body and sits above the CTA, and the button label is tiny, so the hierarchy is inverted. B: it has the same broken header (tiny sun, wordmark outside the dark band) and the same misplaced, unreadable eyebrow. There are also big dead gaps around it. But the CTA is a sensible size with a readable label, and the legal text sits subordinate below it, so the reading order is closer to the original.
